levels.title: First Day on the Job
levels.task: Your supervisor wants a quick overview of the latest top hits. "Can you pull up everything from our top_songs database?" she asks. It's your first task-just show the entire table so you can get familiar with the data.
levels.hintMessage: Use SELECT * to grab all the columns and FROM top_songs to choose the table.
levels.successMessage: Great job! You've successfully retrieved the entire top songs list.

levels.title: Select Specific Column
levels.task: You've been asked to help with a playlist curation project. Your boss wants you to alphabetize the song titles so the creative team can browse ideas easily. Show the songs column in alphabetical order.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name FROM top_songs ORDER BY track_name;
levels.hintMessage: Select the title column with `SELECT track_name`, then sort with `ORDER BY track_name`.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The team can now browse songs in alphabetical order.

levels.title: Select Distinct
levels.task: The A&R team (the team responsible for finding new artists) wants to see which artists are in the Top 50 chart. They don’t want repeats-just one mention per artist.
levels.hintMessage: Use `SELECT DISTINCT artist FROM top_songs` so each artist appears once.
levels.successMessage: Nicely done! Now the A&R team has a clean list of artists to review.

levels.title: Sorting with ORDER BY
levels.task: Your boss is curious about how release timing affects popularity. She asks you to organize the songs by release date so she can look for trends. Provide a list that shows the most recent release dates first.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist, release_date FROM top_songs ORDER BY release_date DESC;
levels.hintMessage: Use ORDER BY release_date. Add DESC to get the most recent songs first.
levels.successMessage: Awesome work! Your boss is already spotting some interesting patterns.

levels.title: Select with ORDER BY
levels.task: Another intern is building an artist spotlight wall. She needs a list of all top songs, but sorted by artist so she can group them visually. Can you help her get that list?
levels.solution: SELECT track_name, artist FROM top_songs ORDER BY artist;
levels.hintMessage: You can sort alphabetically using ORDER BY artist.
levels.successMessage: Spot-on! Your intern friend says this will make her job way easier.
